# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **m154 engine and docs**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 refreshes the bundled Skia renderer and makes package API documentation more accessible. NuGet packages now carry compiler-generated XML documentation, while the binding and documentation tooling have been modernized for more consistent API reference content.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m154 bug fixes** — Updates the bundled renderer with upstream Chrome m154 fixes, including a buffer-upload correction. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054), [#5114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5114))

## API Surface

- **Package API documentation improved** — NuGet packages now include compiler-generated XML documentation, with API comments and Markdown-capable remarks supplying richer reference content in supported IDEs. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))
